text: Low-angle shot looking up at lab equipment against a pale wall and white ceiling. Right of centre, a vertical aluminium extrusion column runs from bottom to top, with a bolted metal plate (about eight visible screws) mid-height and a small grey sensor or camera clipped near its top, a thin black cable hanging down from it. At lower left, a black slotted tube rack or holder sits on a white/grey base; one tube is visible in it, capped with an orange cap, its body white/clear. Behind the rack is a purple-and-white sign bearing a QR-style code; a second black-and-white marker tag appears at bottom centre. A white wall sign at right reads "...Area".
